steps.title: Sofia: account fee comparison · part 1
steps.detail: Sofia asks for an account fee comparison. Their evidence contains an unresolved question. What should the first draft do?

choices.label: Document the question and ask for evidence

steps.title: Sofia: account fee comparison · part 2
steps.detail: The account fee comparison now has conflicting notes. Sofia wants a version that other people can check. How do you resolve the conflict?

choices.label: Compare sources and record what remains uncertain

steps.title: Sofia: account fee comparison · part 3
steps.detail: Sofia is ready to introduce a paying client for the account fee comparison. The client asks for a promise you cannot verify. What do you put in the handover?

choices.label: State the agreed scope, limits and evidence

referral.detail: A referred client commissions a documented account fee comparison. Complete the agreed work; no revenue is earned merely for knowing Sofia.
